## Harness Version Inconsistencies

### [universal_failure] S3.worst_cell_wr

worst_cell_wr_pass=False for ALL models despite ratios 2.5-5.4. This sub-gate appears structurally impossible or has a different meaning than expected (possibly requires ALL cells above threshold).

### [harness_gate_change] S4

S4 kurtosis gate appears to have changed: 176b passes at ratio=0.8156 (v2_s3fixed, no gate recorded), 183c passes at ratio=0.5070 (v2_s3mrj), 179b fails at ratio=0.4732 (v2_s3mrj). 185a/186a show gate_lo=0.8, gate_hi=1.25 (v2_s3mrjspec). Earlier harness used gate_lo=0.5, later tightened to 0.8.

### [sub_pass_contradiction] S10

182a: aggregate_pass=True, active_pass=True, corr_pass=True, but full_horizon.overall_pass=False (active_profile_pass=False). The full-horizon multi-step check is a stricter gate than the single-step aggregate.

### [universal_failure] S7

S7 layer2_pass=False for ALL 9 models. Layer2 regime-cell coverage is the universal blocker. Best: 177a/178b at 3/8, most at 1/8. This is the hardest remaining suite.

### [regression] overall

Clear regression after 183c peak: 183c=9/11, 185a=6/11, 186a=5/11. 185a lost S4,S8,S10. 186a further lost S2,S8,S11.
